_: Books whose chapter text pages the review held back, each with the reason its chapter pages give readers. Both the build and the oracle read this file. A book comes off the list when an export fixes what its reason names and a read of its pages agrees; the commit that takes it off says so. Written 2026-10-13 from a read of three chapters of every book against text_latex, at pd-books 3372745; Todhunter alone was released (one table shown as source). Whitehead released 2026-10-13 at pd-books 040cb80 after a reread of all 19 chapters (nothing lost or doubled, no formula as source). Planck and De Morgan released 2026-10-14 at pd-books 2b5fd80 after a reread of every chapter (Planck's last finding, equation numbers over formulas at narrow widths, was the site's and is fixed). Boyden released 2026-10-14 at pd-books a64be42: every chapter reread at 32a4d2b, its one remaining illustration and the complex fractions checked on the page at a64be42. Since 2026-10-16 a book's text is published only when it is listed under "released": a book new to the export (Granville, the first transcribed from a scan) is withheld with the "unread" reason until a read of its pages releases it, instead of being published because no one had listed it.
unread: its text has not yet been read against the printed book, so it is held until that read is done
